text:
Maria: Quick sync — we need cross-team alignment for the upcoming private-pilot launch. Primary asks: latency SLOs, dedicated capacity sizing, HSM/KMS gating, and rollout sequencing. Who can own sequencing and a short ETA for their piece?
Oliver: I can own capacity. FYI: Dedicated pool is constrained right now — we can get a 4x8 GPU reserved burst but need commit by Apr 12 to reserve. ETA for final sizing: 2 business days.
Sasha: Runtime notes: to hit 95p chat latency <150ms we must enable prefix KV caching + continuous batching config (small batch path). I’ll run perf spikes Mon and post numbers. Assumptions: typical seq len 512, kv-hit >= 60%. ETA: test results Mon EOD.
Dean: Infra: prewarm/autoscaler changes + node image bake need validation. I need a 3-day window to smoke test in staging and a quota request to infra-ops. Blocking: confirmation of reserved commit (Oliver).
Andre: From product/eng: rollout plan = canary 10% -> 30% -> full over 48h with automated rollback if error-rate >1% or >5% latency regressions vs baseline. I can draft the rollout playbook today.
Security: @Maria we need HSM cert provisioning + KMS access approvals + audit checklist. Realistic lead time: ~2 weeks (legal & infra approvals included). If you need faster, we can do a scoped pilot with encrypted-in-transit only (no HSM) but that weakens compliance case.
deploy-bot: INF-4821 created and assigned: "Pilot capacity & HSM gating". Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4821
Maria: Thanks all. Request: please drop one short bullet in this thread with owner + ETA + one blocker by EOD so I can roll into the launch checklist doc (https://docs.redwood.com/pilot-private-launch).
Sasha: Sasha — owner: runtime perf tests + batching config. ETA: Mon EOD (1719090000). Blocker: current model variant needs a small-quant path test to validate latency at seq512.
Oliver: Oliver — owner: capacity sizing & reserve. ETA: Wed EOD (1719176400). Blocker: needs written approval from finance for temporary reserved commit.
Dean: Dean — owner: infra prewarm & autoscaler. ETA: Thu EOD (1719262800). Blocker: need reserved pool details (count/type) from Oliver to set scaling policies.
Andre: Andre — owner: rollout playbook + canary metrics. ETA: Today EOD (1719016000). Blocker: need the final SLO definition (latency percentile + error threshold).
Security: Security — owner: HSM/KMS gating & audit checklist. ETA: 2 weeks (1719830400). Blocker: legal signoff and HSM operator access list.
Maria: I'll consolidate these into the launch checklist and schedule a 30m triage tomorrow to finalize sequencing. Tentative time: tomorrow 10:30am PT. Please RSVP. :thumbsup:
Oliver: RSVP +1.
Sasha: RSVP.
Dean: RSVP, I’ll bring the infra test plan.
Andre: RSVP, will bring rollout playbook draft.
Security: Will attend and bring audit timeline.
Maria: Action items captured, thanks. I’ll update the doc with the INF ticket and people assignments after the triage.
